title: Responsive Layout & Live Metrics in SessionAnalytics
description: Add responsive breakpoints for panel collapse at narrow widths and connect live word count metrics to SessionAnalyticsPanel
action: Add Tailwind responsive utilities to the intelligence panel container: panels should stack vertically below lg (1024px) breakpoint using flex-col class. Ensure no horizontal overflow at any viewport width. For live metrics: extend the uiSlice (from TASK-016) with wordMetrics: { wordCount: number, charCount: number, readingTime: number } state. Update NikoEditor onUpdate to dispatch word metrics to the store. Update SessionAnalyticsPanel to read wordMetrics from the store and display a live word count summary section.

criteria: Panel container or layout has responsive Tailwind classes (lg:, flex-col, or similar)
convergence.verification: Run npx vitest run. Verify SessionAnalyticsPanel shows live metrics. Check responsive classes in panel container.
convergence.definition_of_done: Panels collapse gracefully at narrow widths, SessionAnalyticsPanel shows live word count updating as user types

files.change: Add wordMetrics: { wordCount: number, charCount: number, readingTime: number } to state, add updateWordMetrics action
Dispatch word metrics to uiSlice store in onUpdate callback
Read wordMetrics from useAppStore and display live word count section

implementation: In uiSlice.ts: add wordMetrics: { wordCount: 0, charCount: 0, readingTime: 0 } to initial state
In uiSlice.ts: add updateWordMetrics(metrics: Partial<typeof wordMetrics>) action
In NikoEditor.tsx onUpdate: call useAppStore.getState().updateWordMetrics({ wordCount: words, charCount: chars, readingTime })
In SessionAnalyticsPanel.tsx: add const wordMetrics = useAppStore(s => s.wordMetrics)
In SessionAnalyticsPanel.tsx: render word count stats section with live updating values
In panel container/layout: add responsive Tailwind classes (flex flex-col lg:flex-row) for graceful collapse
Ensure no element causes horizontal overflow at any viewport width
Run: npx vitest run to verify no regressions

unit: SessionAnalyticsPanel renders word count from store

reference.pattern: Zustand store state updates from editor callbacks, Tailwind responsive utilities
reference.examples: See how other store slices update state from component callbacks

rationale.chosen_approach: Shared Zustand state for word metrics avoids prop drilling and excessive re-renders
decision_factors: Live metrics must update as user types without re-renders
Responsive layout uses Tailwind utilities already in the project
rationale.tradeoffs: Word metrics in global store — acceptable as they're needed by multiple components

risks: Excessive re-renders from word count updates — mitigated by Zustand selector granularity and debounce if needed
